reading: The GR point is a local MAXIMUM of the W = const potential: a light dilaton cannot rest there with this W.
At the W = const minimum, alpha_DEF = 0.19, about 50x the Cassini limit, so the dilaton there must be heavy (Yukawa range below the ~0.05 mm torsion-balance scale, mass above ~5 meV).

A pinned dilaton cannot also roll as dark energy. So the Spiral (rolling dilaton) and a fixed F exclude each other: either the dilaton rolls and F is free, or it is pinned and the late field is the axion alone with one of the discrete F values above.
F = (4/pi) sqrt(6) = 3.119 at the GR point is the 'sqrt(6)'-type value already listed in MIRROR_MAP row 10.
